'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[UNICEF]] decries the nearly 3,000 child casualties in Gaza, saying that it is a "growing stain on our collective conscience, the rate of death and injuries of children is simply staggering". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)]
***Three more [[UNRWA]] staff members are killed, thereby bringing the total to 38. Around 219 educational facilities have been damaged, including at least 29 UNRWA schools. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)] [https://ochaopt.org/content/hostilities-gaza-strip-and-israel-flash-update-19 (OCHA)]
***A total of 101 [[medical personnel]] have been killed by Israeli attacks, with 100 others injured. Fifty [[ambulance]]s have also been damaged, with half of them currently unusable. Hospitals are currently operating at more than 150 percent of their capacity, with around 166 unsafe [[Childbirth|births]] occurring each day. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)] 
***Around 200,000 housing units have been partially or completely destroyed in Gaza, representing 45 percent of all housing in the enclave. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/longform/2023/10/26/satellite-images-show-scale-of-destruction-in-israels-assault-on-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Oxfam]] says that Israel is using [[starvation]] as a "weapon of war" as the blockade of Gaza continues. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/26/hamas-and-israel-at-war-what-we-know-on-day-20 (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.miragenews.com/gaza-civilians-face-starvation-as-war-weapon-1110962/ (Mirage News)] 
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] tanks enter northern Gaza in a "targeted raid", with the IDF saying that this is in preparation for the "next stages of combat". [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/israel-gaza-war-live-updates-netanyahu-says-israel-is-preparing-for-a-ground-incursion/ar-AA1iRCkN (''The Washington Post'' via MSN)]
**[[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel]]
***Hamas' [[Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades]] launch rockets intended to strike [[Tel Aviv]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)]
**The death toll in Gaza increases to more than 7,000 people with an estimated 1.4 million people [[internally displaced]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)]
**Israel continues raids and arrests in the [[West Bank]], where Palestinian authorities say that more than 1,200 people have been detained. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[United States National Security Council|U.S. National Security Council]] spokesperson [[John Kirby (admiral)|John Kirby]] reports that the [[Russian Armed Forces]] [[Capital punishment in Russia|execute]] [[Insubordination|insubordinate]] personnel during its offensive in [[eastern Ukraine]]. [https://politics.com.ph/2023/10/27/russia-executing-soldiers-refusing-orders-in-new-ukraine-assault-w-house/ (AFP via Politiko)]
*[[Afghan conflict]]
**[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
***Four people are killed and seven others are injured in an explosion at a [[sports club]] in [[Dashte Barchi]], [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. The [[Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20231027-islamic-state-jihadist-group-claims-deadly-blast-in-kabul (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
***Five suspected [[Lashkar-e-Taiba]] members are killed in a [[shootout]] with the [[Indian Army]] near the [[Line of Control]] in [[Kashmir]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/28/world/asia-oceania/5-suspected-rebels-killed-in-kashmir-clash/1916796 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels launch an [[Offensive (military)|offensive]] in Bambo, north of [[Goma]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], leading to significant displacement of residents. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/10/26/democratic-republic-of-congo-rocked-by-new-m23-rebel-offensive_6206156_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] [[Battle of Nyala|capture]] [[Nyala, Sudan|Nyala]] and the rest of [[South Darfur]], marking a strategic victory for the RSF. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67226076.amp (BBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–24 South Pacific cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Lola]] is downgraded after causing widespread damage in [[Vanuatu]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/501016/all-clear-given-in-vanuatu-lola-downgraded-to-ex-tropical-cyclone (RNZ)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–United States relations]]
***In the first vote under new [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Speaker]] [[Mike Johnson (Louisiana politician)|Mike Johnson]], the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] passes a [[Resolution (law)|resolution]] that declares [[United States|U.S.]] solidarity with [[Israel]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/25/us/politics/house-israel-vote.html (''The New York Times'')]
***The office of [[Florida]] [[Governor of Florida|Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] announces that it is sending [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] and weapons to Israel to support its fight against [[Hamas]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/4277339-desantis-sending-drones-weapons-ammunition-to-israel/ (''The Hill'')]
**In a joint statement, the foreign ministers of [[Bahrain]], [[Egypt]], [[Jordan]], [[Kuwait]], [[Morocco]], [[Oman]], [[Qatar]], [[Saudi Arabia]], and the [[United Arab Emirates]] condemn the [[forced displacement]] and [[collective punishment]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/israel-palestinians-arabs-statement-idAFKBN31Q1KE (Reuters)]
**The [[Israel]] and [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] director at [[Human Rights Watch]] states that the Palestinian death toll provided by the [[Ministry of Health, Palestine|Health Ministry]] is generally reliable, after [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] questioned the death tolls. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Amnesty International]] issues a statement calling for an immediate [[ceasefire]] to stop the increasing death toll and to ensure crucial aid reaches Gaza amid an "unprecedented [[humanitarian]] catastrophe". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2023/10/israel-opt-urgent-call-for-an-immediate-ceasefire-by-all-parties-to-end-unprecedented-civilian-suffering/ (Amnesty International)]
*[[Reactions to the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Slovakia–Ukraine relations]]
***[[Slovak Prime Minister]] [[Robert Fico]] announces the cessation of [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|military aid]] to [[Ukraine]], emphasizing [[List of humanitarian aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|humanitarian support]] instead. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/28/world/americas-emea/slovakia-says-informed-eu-its-halting-military-aid-to-ukraine/1916686 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**An [[Judicial system of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Iranian court]] orders the U.S. to pay [[United States dollar|$]]420 million as [[damages]] for the victims of the failed [[Operation Eagle Claw]] during the [[Iran hostage crisis]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/iran-court-orders-us-to-pay-damages-for-1980-hostage-rescue-attempt-/7328783.html (AFP via VOA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Ulan Japarov, the nephew of [[Kyrgyzstan]] [[President of Kyrgyzstan|President]] [[Sadyr Japarov]], is placed under [[house arrest]] for the remainder of his prison [[sentence (law)|sentence]] after being sentenced for corruption charges. [https://akipress.com/news:739619:President_Japarov_s_nephew_placed_under_house_arrest/ (AKIPress)]
*[[Myanmar Police Force|Myanmar police]] arrest 95 individuals in [[Yangon]] during a crackdown on [[Internet fraud|online scams]] which have targeted Chinese citizens and those of other [[Southeast Asia]]n nations. [https://en.prothomalo.com/international/south-asia/ape3vviymg (AFP via ''Prothom Alo'')]
*The [[Supreme Court of Korea]] [[Acquittal|acquits]] [[Sejong University]] professor [[Park Yu-ha]], previously convicted for [[defamation]] regarding her portrayal of [[comfort women]] in her 2013 book ''Comfort Women of the Empire''. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/27/world/asia-oceania/south-korean-academic-acquitted-of-defaming-comfort-women/1916634 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Salvadoran general election]]
**Incumbent Salvadoran President [[Nayib Bukele]] officially registers his 2024 re-election campaign with the [[Supreme Electoral Court (El Salvador)|Supreme Electoral Court]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/salvadoran-leader-makes-re-election-bid-official-2023-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[Dean Phillips 2024 presidential campaign]]
***[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] ([[Minnesota's 3rd congressional district|MN-03]]) and businessman [[Dean Phillips]] launches his campaign for the [[2024 Democratic Party presidential primaries|Democratic nomination]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/4278819-dean-phillips-officially-challenging-biden-in-2024-presidential-race/ (''The Hill'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**The [[China National Space Administration]] successfully launches [[Shenzhou 17]], a [[List of crewed spacecraft|crewed spacecraft]] carrying three crew members, from the [[Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center]]. The spacecraft will dock with the [[Tiangong space station]] and replace the current crew of [[Shenzhou 16]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/chinas-shenzhou-17-mission-takes-off-for-space-station/a-67217642? (DW)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Fans of [[Scottish Premiership|Scotland]]'s [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic Football Club]] defy their club's directives and wave thousands of [[Flag of Palestine|Palestinian flags]] during their team's [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage|Champions League]] match against [[Atlético Madrid]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2023/10/26/celtic-vs-atletico-madrid-fans-palestine-support-flags-champions-league (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023–24 NHL season]]
**In [[ice hockey]], the [[National Hockey League]] announces that they have suspended [[Ottawa Senators]] [[Centre (ice hockey)|center]] [[Shane Pinto]] for 41 games after violating the league's rules on [[Sports betting|sports gambling]], making him the first player to be suspended for gambling. [https://www.cbssports.com/nhl/news/senators-shane-pinto-hit-with-nhls-first-ever-gambling-related-suspension-will-serve-41-game-ban/ (CBS Sports)]
